Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried out 
when the bearing temperature > 80 o C as 
indicated in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdo 
Abdo El Hendawy, tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla at 02 April 2003 on 
Boiler no. 4 and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, 
accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector of Demiatta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Be sure the seal air blower is stopped
Disconnect the power supply of the seal air fan motor
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Tools and Equipment
Hex. keys,
 Alin kit,
 Screw driver, Dig hummer
Work to be Carried Out
Dismantle the all components
Check the impeller for (crakes, wear, and deformation) and change it if 
 necessary
Check and repair or change the shaft and shaft packing
Check the coupling flexible intermediate ring change if it bad
Check the roller bearing (noise-temp.) normal temp. 50-80oC & 
 visual test check
Clean the bearing and add new grease
Check the alignment of the shaft coupling
Fitting a new flexible intermediate ring
Unscrew and remove the guard
Detach the motor and push it backwards
Replace the intermediate ring
Pull coupling and motor back in place and screw tight
Re-mount guard and screw tight.
Return the Seal Air Fan to 
 Service
Return the work order to 
 the shift engineer to prepare the procedures
Prepare 
 the seal fan for operation
Record 
 the readings at the MRDS
